subject: general
question: Who wrote the novel 'A Suitable Boy'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Seth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vikram Seth** is the author of the novel **'A Suitable Boy'**, published in 1993.
 
• The book is one of the longest novels ever published in a single volume, with over 1,300 pages.
 
• 'A Suitable Boy' is set in post-independence India (1950s) and revolves around the lives of four families, focusing on the search for a suitable match for Lata Mehra, the protagonist.
 
• The novel explores themes such as family dynamics, love, politics, and religious tensions in India.
 
• Vikram Seth is a celebrated Indian author and poet, known for works like 'The Golden Gate' (1986) and 'An Equal Music' (1999).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Salman Rushdie**

 
 
• Salman Rushdie is a renowned Indian-British author known for his contributions to magical realism.
 
• His most famous work is **'Midnight's Children'**, which won the Booker Prize in 1981 and depicts post-independence India through the lens of magical realism.
 
• Other notable works by Rushdie include 'The Satanic Verses,' 'The Moor's Last Sigh,' and 'Shalimar the Clown.'
 
 
 
• **Chetan Bhagat**
 
 
• Chetan Bhagat is a contemporary Indian author known for his best-selling novels, typically based on modern Indian youth and their struggles.
 
• Some of his famous works include **'Five Point Someone,' '2 States,' and 'The 3 Mistakes of My Life.'**
 
• His books have been adapted into popular Bollywood movies such as '3 Idiots,' 'Kai Po Che!,' and '2 States.'
 
 
 
• **Manu Joseph**
 
 
• Manu Joseph is an Indian journalist and author known for his satirical and insightful writings.
 
• His famous novels include **'Serious Men'** (winner of The Hindu Literary Prize) and 'The Illicit Happiness of Other People.'
 
• 'Serious Men' was adapted into a Netflix film in 2020, further cementing his reputation as a prominent contemporary writer.
